name: Preixana (Spain)
description: Yellow field crossed lengthwise by two adjoining wavy stripes, black above and light blue below.
history: The official flag of Preixana is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, yellow, crossed lengthwise by two adjoining waves, black the upper and light blue the lower, each of width one sixth of the flag; approved on 3 October 1989 and published in the DOGC on 18 October 1989.

features.role: upper wavy stripe of 1/6 of the height
lower wavy stripe of 1/6 of the height, adjoining the black
